notes.title: Tinboy - Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The publisher has changed. ːsteamhappyː
We recovered Tinboy after 3 years and we decided to update the game and also bring it to Nintendo Switch and Xbox One.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9989729/9aa39f7115b5f8f5126df81d2c64856fe1b44237.gif
What's in this update:

 Improved controls
 Controller Support
 Achievements
 Mac & Linux version
 New languages


Also please check out our latest game: Gray Dawn - The adventure of a cursed priest

Thank you :)
